acquisition: tools/migration-reference-field.c and tools/migration-reference-geometry.py compile frozen baseline CPU code only. Never linked into the application. Raw full buffers remain scratch artifacts.
fieldScope: signed cell/noise/habitat grid, 256m spline knots, rail cut/fill widths, actual lake centres and 0/5/70m shore thresholds, tree/boulder collision centres, standable coordinate boundary
geometryScope: all material vertices, active bones and complete sampled height grids immediately before upload; fixed 3 scenes and 24 chunks across 3 seeds and signed positions. Water topology is separately generated by raylib.
independence: Expected values come from source at the released baseline. This detects porting drift; shared scenic-design mistakes require independent sampling laws/negative controls and actual GPU observations.

alpineRounding.cause: Ordinary Float atan2 differs by one ULP between native clang libm and GHC; preserve normal Haskell operations rather than add custom math FFI solely for baseline bits.
alpineRounding.scope: Only fixed Alpine terrain height and derived normals; 26 other complete geometries exact, all Alpine topology/vegetation/bones/colors/UV exact.
